title: Nineveh Believes God
backstory: God spoke to the fish, and it put Jonah out on dry land (Jonah 2:10). Then the word of the LORD came to him a second time with the very same errand: Arise, go unto Nineveh (Jonah 3:1-2). This time Jonah went. Nineveh was an exceeding great city of three days' journey (Jonah 3:3), and no one there expected what one walking prophet was about to say.

passages.synopsis: The word of the LORD came to Jonah a second time. Go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach what I tell you. This time Jonah arose and went, just as the LORD said. Nineveh was an exceeding great city, three days' journey across.

Jonah walked a day's journey into the city and cried out: yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown. Amazingly, the people of Nineveh believed God. From the greatest to the least they proclaimed a fast and put on sackcloth. Even the king rose from his throne, laid aside his robe, and sat down in ashes.

The king sent a decree through Nineveh: let neither man nor beast eat or drink. Everyone was to wear sackcloth, cry mightily to God, and turn from evil and violence. Who can tell, said the king, if God will turn from his fierce anger so we do not perish. God saw that they turned from their evil way, and he did not bring the destruction he had spoken of.

whoAmIChars.name: Jonah
clues: I ran away when God first called me, and a great fish brought me back.
God gave me a second chance to preach to a great and fearsome city.
I walked into Nineveh crying that in forty days it would be overthrown.

whoAmIChars.name: The King of Nineveh
clues: I ruled a city so great it took three days to cross.
When God's warning reached me, I came down from my throne.
I put on sackcloth, sat in ashes, and told my whole city to fast.

triviaQuestions.question: What did Jonah cry as he entered Nineveh?
options: Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown
triviaQuestions.explanation: Jonah 3:4 — "And Jonah began to enter into the city a day’s journey, and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown."

triviaQuestions.question: What did the people of Nineveh do when they believed God?
options: They proclaimed a fast and put on sackcloth
triviaQuestions.explanation: Jonah 3:5 — "So the people of Nineveh believed God, and proclaimed a fast, and put on sackcloth, from the greatest of them even to the least of them."

triviaQuestions.question: What did the king of Nineveh do when the word reached him?
options: He rose from his throne and sat in ashes
triviaQuestions.explanation: Jonah 3:6 — "For word came unto the king of Nineveh, and he arose from his throne, and he laid his robe from him, and covered him with sackcloth, and sat in ashes."

triviaQuestions.question: What did God do when he saw Nineveh turn from its evil way?
options: He did not do the evil he had said he would do
He sent fire upon the city
triviaQuestions.explanation: Jonah 3:10 — "And God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way; and God repented of the evil, that he had said that he would do unto them; and he did it not."

reflection: The great and fearsome city of Nineveh heard one preacher and turned to God, and God showed mercy. Is anyone too far gone for God to forgive?
